notes:
You can now dim the background itself in distraction-free mode. Until now the only slider there fed the page, not the picture behind it - and it was labelled “Background visibility”, which is why you may have dragged it and watched your own page fade instead. There are two sliders now, each named for what it changes: one fades the page over the background, the new one dims the image or video. The background keeps whatever you set when you swap it for another.

The ambient sound sliders no longer fight back. Dragging one made it jump and flicker, and left your pointer on the pause button, because the play button only appeared once a sound was audible - arriving beside the slider mid-drag and shoving it sideways under your finger. It now holds its place whether the sound is playing or not. Dragging also used to start several copies of the same loop, and all but one of them ignored the slider, the pause button and even stop-all; now a drag starts exactly one.

macOS: Corylus is not notarized yet, so Gatekeeper may say the app cannot be opened because the developer cannot be verified. Right-click (or Control-click) Corylus.app, choose Open, then Open again. Only needed once per downloaded copy.
